name: Bolt of Glory
description: Ranged touch ray of positive energy. Deals (min(CASTERLEVEL,14)/2)d6 damage (max 7d6) to creatures of the Material/Elemental Planes and neutral outsiders, or (min(CASTERLEVEL,15))d6 (max 15d6) to undead, evil outsiders, and creatures of the Negative Energy Plane. Good outsiders are unharmed.
